x: Eddie ran a fine race to finish 13th in his first open race, and Bishop and Adams also ran well. Our team was placed 5th, which was quite creditable seeing that we were without the help of John Weames and J.
Standard medals were won by the following—880 yards—J.
Vern Blowfield won the 1 mile title when beating Stan Cox, the Olympic Games runner. J.

Club records for this race were broken by Jack Brown, Arthur Bruce, Ray Tooby, Len Adams and Eddie Short, and it was a pity that Norris, of T.V.H., beat Eddie’s time, thus depriving him of the course record, but the other four now go on the list of course record-holders. Our actual times and positions were—(1) J.

Shaftesbury Harriers were also present in force and it was agreed to score 10 a side, and although we had four men in the first six home, we lost on aggregate to Shaftesbury, but managed to beat the home club. Placings and times of our runners were—Equal 1, J.
